summary: Implemented and merged project-aware session storage via PR #2. Chats with explicit trusted project scope now route to projects/<project-id>/sessions/<session-id>/session.json with scope=project/project_id metadata; chats without reliable project scope keep the existing sessions/<session-id>/session.json layout. Updated ChatGPT global/project bootstrap docs, AGENTS, SESSION_LINKING, MULTI_AGENT, discovery/runtime metadata, schema, README/llms, and validators. Both GitHub validation workflows passed before merge. Existing sessions require no migration. Important operational note: the owner's currently pasted ChatGPT Custom Instructions still contain the old hard-coded standalone path and must be replaced with the updated CHATGPT_GLOBAL_BOOTSTRAP.md text for global behavior to follow the new routing; each ChatGPT Project should use CHATGPT_PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md with a unique stable PROJECT_ID.
